stories.summary: Shruti Haasan says one of the strangest residents of her Mumbai home was a life-sized mannequin that refused to stay in place. stories.title: Raj Thackeray accuses BJP of using Chhath Puja to fuel divide between Marathis and North Indians
stories.summary: A day after his partymen staged protests against Chhath pooja at Banganga, opposing Bhojpuri songs being played at suburban railway stations, the Maharashtra Navnirman Sena (MNS) chief Raj Thackeray on Friday alleged the ruling BJP was using the festival to create a rift between north Indians and sons of the soil, with an eye on the upcoming Uttar Pradesh elections.

stories.title: Two booked for setting off rockets near Thane hospital

stories.summary: The agreement was signed on November 12, with the new 9-metre buses expected to improve last-mile connectivity, reduce waiting time at bus stops and serve areas where larger buses cannot easily operate. The move is significant for commuters travelling to and from Metro stations, particularly in densely populated neighbourhoods with narrow roads and heavy traffic.

stories.title: Court rejects anticipatory bail of advocate in forgery case
stories.summary: A sessions court recently rejected the anticipatory bail plea of Ahmedabad-based advocate Ruchita Kedia, holding that custodial interrogation was necessary in a probe involving an allegedly forged cancellation deed used in a debenture-security transaction. The case was related to a complaint by a legal representative of Beacon Trusteeship Company against directors of M H Infraprojects Ltd and others over alleged cheating, criminal breach of trust, conspiracy and forgery.

stories.title: Prince William to attend Earthshot Prize awards in Mumbai on November 17
stories.summary: Britain’s Prince William will attend the Earthshot Prize awards ceremony in Mumbai on November 17, marking the first time the global environmental awards, which he founded in 2020, will be held in India. The sixth edition of the event is expected to bring together 5,000 guests, including environmental innovators, business leaders, philanthropists and celebrities from across the world.

stories.title: Two accidents, followed by a fire, led to a six-vehicle pile-up within a span of 15 minutes inside the Coastal Road tunnel
stories.summary: Two accidents involving six vehicles in the left-hand-side (LHS) tunnel of the Mumbai Coastal Road, followed by a fire, within a span of 15 minutes led to a pile-up and the temporary closure of the tunnel at around 3 am on Friday. The incident resulted in traffic movement in the LHS tunnel being suspended for over an hour.

stories.title: Mumbai weather: Morning haze and daytime heat persist as AQI stands at 127
stories.summary: Mumbai continues to experience warmer weather, with a layer of haze covering parts of the city during the early morning hours on Saturday, November 14. The temperatures have shown a marginal dip during the early hours, whereas hot and humid conditions continue to persist through the day. Residents have been experiencing relatively cooler conditions in the morning, offering some respite from the warmth.

stories.title: Mumbai: 4 men, including 2 minors, held for gangraping 14-year-old in Kandivali
stories.summary: Four men, including two minors, were apprehended for allegedly gangraping a 14-year-old girl on two occasions in Maharashtra’s Kandivali after blackmailing her with threats to circulate a video purportedly showing her bathing. The men allegedly exploited the girl by claiming to possess a private video of her and threatening to share it on social media if she did not comply with their demands.

stories.title: Life convict arrested for assaulting restaurant manager over Rs 11,100 bill
stories.summary: A life convict who had spent nearly 12 years behind bars and had earlier escaped from police custody has landed in fresh trouble after allegedly assaulting a restaurant manager and forcibly taking money from him during a dispute over a bill. The accused, identified as Ganesh Devdas Shinde alias Ganya, was recently released on three-month parole and has now been arrested by Sion Police along with two other accused.

stories.title: Thane: Three cars catch fire near SMG School on Diva-Agasan Road
stories.summary: Three four-wheeler vehicles caught fire near S M G School on Diva-Agasan Road in Diva East, Thane, on Saturday, November 14. While two cars were completely gutted, another sustained minor damage. No injuries have been reported so far. According to the officials from the Thane Municipal Corporation’s (TMC) fire brigade department , the incident was reported at around 6:37 am.

stories.title: Moushmi Chatterjee's producer husband Jayanta Mukherjee dies at Mumbai home
stories.summary: Veteran producer Jayanta Mukherjee, who was married to actor Moushumi Chatterjee , has died following age-related illness. He was in his late 70s. "He passed away last evening due to age-related issues at his residence in Khar," BN Tiwari, President of the Federation of Western India Cine Employees (FWICE), told PTI.

stories.title: Diwali Firecracker Violations: Mumbai Police Register Over 80 FIRs Across City
stories.summary: Police personnel are not only acting on complaints received from citizens but are also initiating action suo motu when they spot violations during night patrolling. The action assumes significance as firecrackers burst in public places and crowded residential areas can pose a risk to pedestrians, motorists and nearby properties.

stories.title: Mumbai: Amarsons store in Breach Candy reopens less than a month after fire
stories.summary: Amid the carnage and destruction from recent fires, here is a message of hope. Putting the amar (eternal) literally into Amarsons, the Breach Candy store has bounced back from a Level-1 fire which broke out on the morning of October 20, 2026. The store was gutted but fortunately suffered no casualties among staff as it was shuttered at the time of the fire.

stories.title: Mumbai Police May Shut Down, Restructure Specialised Crime Branches Amid Workload Review
stories.summary: The Mumbai Police is likely to shut down or restructure certain specialised branches considered redundant, amid discussions within the force about reducing the number of operational units. stories.title: Fake journalist arrested in Navi Mumbai ₹19 lakh housing fraud case; multiple criminal cases registered against him
stories.summary: The Navi Mumbai Police have arrested a man who allegedly posed as a journalist on social media and cheated people of ₹19 lakh by promising them houses at discounted rates in Ulwe. The accused, identified as Shailendra Dev Prakash Dwivedi, was also wanted in connection with several criminal cases registered across Maharashtra, police said.

stories.title: Mumbai: Broken lift leaves KEM Hospital with several vacant beds
stories.summary: Finding a bed in the orthopaedic ward of KEM Hospital — one of Mumbai’s four major civic-run hospitals — was once a challenge. However, the same ward presents a starkly different picture today, with several beds lying vacant. This is due to a non-functional lift that has turned accessing the ward into an ordeal for patients, particularly those who cannot walk.

stories.summary: Winning India's cleanest city title has put Navi Mumbai’s civic administration under pressure to keep its crown, and the Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation ( NMMC ) is turning to Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ensure that garbage does not pile up again. The civic body plans to install 200 AI-enabled cameras across the city to identify garbage accumulation, monitor litter-prone locations, and help officials respond to sanitation issues.

stories.title: Mumbai Metro Line 4 vs Line 6: Which delayed corridor will open first?
stories.summary: Who will win the title of Mumbai’s most delayed Metro project? Green Line 4 ( Wadala-Thane) and Pink Line 6 (Swami Samarth Nagar-Vikhroli) appear to be neck and neck in the race, with neither showing signs of opening soon. stories.title: Former Madras HC judge CS Karnan, first sitting judge jailed for contempt, dies at 71
stories.summary: Former Madras High Court judge CS Karnan, the first sitting high court judge to be sentenced to imprisonment for contempt of court, died on Friday morning at a private hospital here following age-related health complications.
